issues.title: Tanzania, Morocco agree to introduce Dar- Casablanca direct flights to bolster ties in aviation sector
issues.title_en: Tanzania, Morocco agree to introduce Dar- Casablanca direct flights to bolster ties in aviation sector
issues.summary: MONTREAL: TANZANIA and Morocco have discussed ways of strengthening cooperation in the aviation sector, including plans to introduce direct flights between Dar es Salaam and Casablanca in 2027.
